entries.description: Inventoried all public API surfaces across 37 source files. Identified ~250 public members needing XML documentation.
Added XML doc comments to all public classes, interfaces, structs, and enums. All types already had summary comments; verified and confirmed.
Added XML doc comments (summary, param, returns) to all public and protected constructors across Document, Pdf, Image, and Text namespaces.

Added XML doc comments to all public properties: Rectangle.Width/Height, BaseColor.Red/Green/Blue, PdfDictionary.Count/Keys, PdfArray.Count, PdfNumber.IntValue/DoubleValue, PdfString.Value/OriginalBytes, and all PdfName static constants (~50).
Added XML doc comments to TextLayout.Alignment enum members (Left, Right, Center) and all PdfObject type constants (BOOLEAN through INDIRECT).
dotnet build succeeded with 0 CS1591 warnings, 0 errors. dotnet test: Passed 565, Failed 0. GenerateDocumentationFile enabled in DabblerPdf.csproj.
Cross-provider verification with gemini-pro (1 round). Session review saved to session-reviews/session-001.md.
Cross-provider re-verification with gemini-pro (round 2). Session review saved.

Fixed all 7 issue categories from round 2: added <param> tags to 23 PdfContentByte methods, <returns> tags to PdfObject/PdfBody/PdfCrossReferenceTable, <param>/<returns> to PdfDictionary GetAs methods, Image methods, PdfWriter/PngImage factory methods, CoordinateTranslator. Build: 0 warnings, 0 errors. Tests: 565 passed.
Deleted GEMINI.md from repository root via git rm.
Verified existing LICENSE file: LGPL-2.1/MPL-2.0 dual license matches PackageLicenseExpression in csproj. No changes needed.

Rewrote README.md for NuGet/GitHub audiences: badges, features list, installation (NuGet + submodule), Quick Start examples (text, styling, lines, images, measurement, wrapping, coordinates), API overview table, font support table, samples table, license, contributing.
Audited repo for artifacts: no hardcoded paths, no credentials, no TODO/NOTES files. .gitignore covers bin/, obj/, .user, .suo, Samples/Output/. .env exists locally but is not tracked.
dotnet build succeeded with 0 warnings, 0 errors. dotnet test: Passed 565, Failed 0.
Cross-provider verification with opus (1 round). Session review saved to session-reviews/session-002.md.
Cross-provider re-verification with opus (round 2). All 5 issues from round 1 resolved as false positives (verifier lacked source access). Session review appended.

Added NuGet metadata to DabblerPdf.csproj: PackageId, Version (1.0.0), Authors, Description, PackageTags, PackageProjectUrl, RepositoryUrl, PackageReadmeFile, PackageReleaseNotes, Copyright, Deterministic, IncludeSymbols/snupkg. Kept existing LGPL-2.1/MPL-2.0 license.
Added ItemGroup to include ../../README.md in the NuGet package with Pack=true.
dotnet pack -c Release produced DabblerPdf.1.0.0.nupkg (60KB) and DabblerPdf.1.0.0.snupkg.
Inspected .nupkg contents: lib/net10.0/DabblerPdf.dll, lib/net10.0/DabblerPdf.xml, README.md at root. .nuspec has correct metadata, no unwanted dependencies, no test/sample assemblies. 60KB total.

Created throwaway console project, installed DabblerPdf 1.0.0 from local source, wrote smoke test creating a one-page PDF with Helvetica and Times Roman text. Package installed, compiled, and produced valid 929-byte PDF.
dotnet test: Passed 565, Failed 0, Skipped 0.
All 10 samples generated successfully: basic-text, text-wrapping, lines-and-shapes, colors, images, table-layout, multi-page, padding, invoice, stress-test. 0 failures.
Created CHANGELOG.md at repo root documenting v1.0.0 features: text rendering, font styles, wrapping, measurement API, images, lines, rectangles, colors, padding, headers/footers, page numbering.
